description: SCV workspace guard. Deliberately blocking: it denies writes that no SCV action accounts for. Loaded from the plugin-root default path, so .codex-plugin/plugin.json declares no hooks key. The plugin directory comes from PLUGIN_ROOT (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is the alias this host also sets); there is no CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT, and naming it left the path empty, the script missing, and the guard silently inert. Both entries carry the SAME environment on purpose: SCV_GUARD_SCRIPTS lists the vendored Core scripts AND adapter/scripts (colon-separated, Core 0.28.0+) so the adapter-routed actions mint, and SCV_GUARD_EXEMPT rides on gate-bash too, so a config.toml patch is allowed through the shell path exactly as through the editor path — they diverged once and the same edit was allowed one way and denied the other. The guard fails open only on an empty payload or a missing JSON reader, and is inert in projects that have not adopted SCV. See plugins/scv/vendor/scv-core/core/contracts/guard.md.
